q: Is attendance at Orientation Days mandatory?
a: Yes. Orientation Days deliver the statutory training on student rights and duties, so attendance is mandatory for all first-year students of bachelor's, engineering and master's programmes — all fields of study, including English-language ones, in both full-time and part-time modes.

q: What if I cannot attend Orientation Days?
a: Write to dni.adaptacyjne@samorzad.ue.wroc.pl and we will agree on how you can complete the mandatory training.

q: When will the exact schedule and the campus locations of my Orientation Days be available?
a: The whole project team is working on it right now. We will do our best to publish it as soon as possible, and no later than roughly a week before the event.

q: How should I dress and what should I bring to Orientation Days?
a: The dress code is casual, so wear comfortable clothes and shoes. Bring a charged phone and a good mood. Details on this will appear in our Facebook event closer to October.

q: Where do I find current information before and during Orientation Days?
a: We will post all such information in the Facebook event and on the Student Union's social media. Follow us so you don't miss anything!
